notes.title: Armageddon Onslaught - Update #3
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=m5xNJLnGDdA;full][/previewyoutube]

Some news about Armageddon Onslaught! The release date of the game has been moved to 10 June 2022.

Armageddon Onslaught has several features, including local multiplayer, bullet time, a dynamic dismemberments system, Metroidvania-like maps to explore, devastating weapons, maidens to save from bloodthirsty demons, a badass soundtrack, and most importantly, kick-ass angelic powers.
We'll try to post a new video of the game as soon as possible.

\m/

notes.title: Armageddon Onslaught - Update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37682644/cb168ef6a3afa87ef120a51707707cfd5715938a.gif[/img]

We hope you've had some nice holidays! We start the new year by showing you some new features we added for our upcoming new game Armageddon Onslaught.
As you can see, we decided to add guns to the game, and now the gameplay feeling is completely different, cooler, gory, and badass.
Moreover, you will be able to use angelic powers, but that's another story...
Stay tuned.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274810
